title: The Way Up
description: Cindermoor at last. The Hearthspire stands dark on the crown of the moor, and nobody came down to meet the Mercy but a Hushed boat-warden who counts the slips.

stages.text: The Slow Mercy lies at the Boat Stair, the Keepers' quay under Cindermoor's east cliff, and there's no lane off this water till the Spire's lit. The cinder road goes up from the quay into the fog. Find the way up the moor.

A few yards into the fog the cinder road stops being a road: it has forgotten where it goes, and the ember holds the ground round you but not the way. There are cold iron cressets up the moor, the old waymarks. Somebody lit them once, one after another.

Two cressets lit from the ember, and the cinder road remembered itself up the notch and over the lip. Above it Cindermoor goes up in long steps, and the road zig-zags up them into the fog with a cold cresset at every turn. Light them, and the road will remember as far as the next.

At the top of the long steps, just past where the last cresset's light reaches, the Unmoored sit in the fog. They came to Cindermoor on purpose, because it's thickest here, and the cresset above them on the road has been put out on purpose: raked out and packed with wet cinder.
Past the doused cresset the road went on up to the crown of the moor, and the Hearthspire's foot.
